# ONNX Runtime (Windows x64)

CPU build of [ONNX Runtime 1.22.0](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/releases/tag/v1.22.0), used to run U²-Net-p when adding clothes.

Only `include/` and `lib/*.dll|*.lib` are kept. Re-download:

https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/releases/download/v1.22.0/onnxruntime-win-x64-1.22.0.zip
